variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: Repaired camera/keyframe editing, playback, seeking, Loop, timing, Undo/Redo and camera restoration. Added target-relative XCP placement and synchronized camera preset editing. Quick and Tools now collapse independently. Hand/foot IK works through on-character Move handles. New lights start at the camera; directional transforms and type-specific angle controls are repaired. Leaving GPose clears unsaved drafts, runtime state, history, selections, clipboards and pending imports. Manually saved files remain available for explicit reopening.
